## Pull request overview

Fixes Console list row navigation by removing the `App.tsx`-level `handleRowClick` override and ensuring `ObjectView` consistently routes row clicks through `useNavigationOverlay` so all navigation modes (page/drawer/modal/split/popover/new_window) behave as configured.

**Changes:**
- Removed `handleRowClick` + `useSearchParams` usage from `apps/console/src/App.tsx`, and stopped passing `onRowClick` into Console `ObjectView`.
- Updated `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` to always wire row clicks to `navOverlay.handleClick` (and removed `onRowClick` from props / internal plumbing).
- Added 3 tests covering page-mode navigation, default navigation behavior, and drawer-mode non-navigation.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Removes the global row-click override so navigation mode config isn’t bypassed. |
| apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx | Forces all row clicks through `navOverlay.handleClick` and removes unused `onRowClick`/handler plumbing. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx | Adds regression tests ensuring page/default modes navigate and drawer mode doesn’t trigger page navigation. |
| ROADMAP.md | Documents the bug root cause, fix, and updated test counts. |

`onRowClick` is wrapped in an inline arrow that only forwards to `navOverlay.handleClick`. Since `handleClick` is already a stable callback from `useNavigationOverlay`, consider passing it directly to avoid recreating a new function each render and to preserve referential equality for `ListView` props.
